verdict.rationale: Snyk Code documentation explicitly describes cross-file taint tracking via source-to-sink flow visualization, which is the core taint-analysis capability, and it's positioned as a real SAST engine integrated across IDEs/CI. However, there is no explicit documentation confirming cross-function/cross-file boundary depth, no independent benchmark or hands-on validation of taint-tracking accuracy, and community feedback focuses on dependency/PR tooling rather than SAST taint quality. Missing for 10: explicit cross-file/cross-function taint tracking detail, independent verification of SAST accuracy/coverage, and hands-on confirmation of multi-file flow detection.
